sign_off.notes: I found no defects in the three areas, so I filed no reports. Navigation drawer: storage, bookmarks and category views (Images, Quick access, Audio) all worked. A bookmark added for Alpha showed up in the drawer and opened the right folder. The add-folder button hid in category views and came back on return to a folder. Multi-file overflow: the Select All / Deselect All toggle worked for no, partial and full selection, in a normal folder and in the Images view. Properties dialogs: file and folder sizes were correct, e.g. AndroidQA showed 41.05 kB, matching the file sizes. I did not test the Hide action, because it changes data. The debug build raised a LeakCanary notice, "Found 3 retained objects grouped as 2 distinct leaks (2 new)", which I did not investigate.
